description: Chain-of-thought contracts — enforceable specifications of HOW a model must think before an answer is accepted: the required reasoning STRUCTURE, the ENFORCEMENT mechanism (a deterministic schema/gate, a model/judge, and/or a fine-tuned LoRA/QLoRA adapter that biases the structure in), and the VERIFICATION that the structure was actually followed. A contract makes a 'way of thinking' a checkable obligation, not a hope. Composes with reasoning_strategies (the catalog of thinking MODES the contract can require), lora_adapters / qlora_adapters (the model-side enforcer), and the verification rail (the deterministic enforcer). The descent: prefer the cheapest enforcer that holds — schema gate first, adapter to raise the hit-rate, judge only for the hard cases. serves_truth=false: a contract governs the PROCESS; the governance/provenance rail still gates the truth of the OUTPUT.

contracts.name: Decompose before solve
contracts.enforces: restate the problem and break it into named sub-steps before producing an answer
contracts.verification: deterministic gate rejects output with no decompose section; a judge scores decomposition quality on hard items
contracts.failure_mode_caught: jumping straight to an answer on a multi-part problem

contracts.name: Cite before claim
contracts.enforces: every factual claim carries a source handle at the point it is asserted
contracts.verification: reject any claim lacking a resolvable source_ref; ties directly into the governance/provenance rail

contracts.name: Verify, then answer
contracts.enforces: check the draft answer against the question + constraints and revise before finalizing
contracts.verification: the self_check section must reference each stated constraint; a judge confirms the final addresses the check
contracts.failure_mode_caught: answers that ignore a stated constraint

contracts.name: Consider alternatives before committing
contracts.enforces: enumerate >=N candidate approaches with why-rejected before selecting one
contracts.verification: gate requires >=N distinct candidates with a rejection reason each
contracts.failure_mode_caught: first-idea fixation; the reinvention the observer flags

contracts.name: First-principles required (novel problems)
contracts.enforces: reason from base facts, not memorized patterns/analogy, when the problem is flagged novel
contracts.verification: a judge checks the derivation chains from the stated base facts (not from an asserted pattern)
contracts.failure_mode_caught: pattern-matching a wrong analogy onto a novel problem

contracts.name: Show reproducible work or reject
contracts.enforces: the working must be present and checkable; an answer without reproducible steps is rejected
contracts.verification: re-execute/re-derive the steps deterministically where possible; mismatch -> reject

contracts.name: Bounded uncertainty
contracts.enforces: state confidence and what would change the conclusion; flag overconfident claims
contracts.verification: gate requires the confidence + falsifier fields; a judge flags confidence that outruns the evidence

contracts.name: Stepwise, justified tool use
contracts.enforces: each tool call is justified (why this tool, expected result) before invocation; the result is checked after
contracts.verification: reject a tool call with no rationale/expected_result; the observer's footgun + waste checks watch the post_check
contracts.failure_mode_caught: flailing tool calls; the agentic thrash the supervisor flags
